# Sarath G

> Sarath G is an application security consultant and international
> cybersecurity trainer. 9+ years, 1,600+ instruction hours, corporate
> training delivered to 20+ organisations across 10+ countries onsite in
> Southeast Asia, Europe, Africa and the Middle East, including central
> banks, government agencies and Fortune 500 firms. 30,000+ people trained
> across a career of corporate, college, bootcamp and public sessions.
> Certifications: CEH Master, CPENT, LPT Master, CHFI, CEI, ISC2 CC, WAHS.
> Author of "Certified and Clueless" and the DARE training framework.
